text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san. For today's training, I'd 
like to push the intensity higher than 
planned...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Um, about today's mock race... I couldn't 
run the way I wanted to... and it's so 
frustrating!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Still, I feel like this emotion is really 
important. I want to pour it into my 
running and turn it into strength...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I swear, I'll definitely deliver 
results...! Please!! Let me do it...!!
